column4: What are the ids and names of the battles that led to more than 10 people killed in total.
column5: SELECT T1.id ,  T1.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.id  =  T2.lost_in_battle JOIN death AS T3 ON T2.id  =  T3.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id HAVING sum(T3.killed)  >  10
column6: SELECT T2.id ,  T2.name FROM battle AS T1 JOIN death AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.caused_by_ship_id GROUP BY T1.id ,  T1.name HAVING SUM(T2.killed) > 10

column4: What are the death and injury situations caused by the ship with tonnage 't'?
column5: SELECT T1.killed ,  T1.injured FROM death AS T1 JOIN ship AS t2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.tonnage  =  't'
column6: SELECT T2.note, T3.killed, T3.injured FROM death AS T1 INNER JOIN ship AS T2 ON T1.caused_by_ship_id = T2.id INNER JOIN battle AS T3 ON T2.lost_in_battle = T3.id WHERE T2.tonnage = 't'

column4: For the cars with 4 cylinders, which model has the largest horsepower?
column5: SELECT T1.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Cylinders  =  4 ORDER BY T2.horsepower DESC LIMIT 1;
column6: SELECT T2.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.ModelId WHERE T1.Cylinders = 4 ORDER BY T1.Horsepower DESC LIMIT 1

column4: Which distinctive models are produced by maker with the full name General Motors or weighing more than 3500?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN MODEL_LIST AS T2 ON T1.Model  =  T2.Model JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T3 ON T2.Maker  =  T3.Id JOIN CARS_DATA AS T4 ON T1.MakeId  =  T4.Id WHERE T3.FullName  =  'General Motors' OR T4.weight  >  3500;
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Model FROM car_makers AS T1 INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Id = T2.Maker WHERE T1.FullName = 'General Motors' OR T2.Weight > 3500

column4: What is the model for the car with a weight smaller than the average?
column5: SELECT T1.model FROM CAR_NAMES AS T1 JOIN CARS_DATA AS T2 ON T1.MakeId  =  T2.Id WHERE T2.Weight  <  (SELECT avg(Weight) FROM CARS_DATA)
column6: SELECT T2.Model FROM cars_data AS T1 INNER JOIN car_names AS T2 ON T1.MakeId = T2.Make WHERE T1.Weight < (SELECT AVG(Weight) FROM cars_data)

column4: List all song names by singers above the average age.
column5: SELECT song_name FROM singer WHERE age  >  (SELECT avg(age) FROM singer)
column6: SELECT T2.song_name FROM singer AS T1 INNER JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.singer_id = T2.singer_id GROUP BY T1.singer_id HAVING AVG(T1.age) > ( SELECT avg(age) FROM singer )

column4: List all singer names in concerts in year 2014.
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.singer_id  =  T2.singer_id JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.concert_id  =  T3.concert_id WHERE T3.year  =  2014
column6: SELECT T3.Name FROM singer AS T1 INNER JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID INNER JOIN concert AS T3 ON T2.concert_ID = T3.concert_ID WHERE T3.Year = '2014'

column4: What is the name and country of origin of every singer who has a song with the word 'Hey' in its title?
column5: SELECT name ,  country FROM singer WHERE song_name LIKE '%Hey%'
column6: SELECT T2.Name, T2.Country FROM singer AS T1 INNER JOIN singer_in_concert AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID WHERE T1.Song_Name LIKE '%Hey%'

column4: What are the names of the teachers and the courses they teach in ascending alphabetical order by the name of the teacher?
column5: SELECT T3.Name ,  T2.Course FROM course_arrange AS T1 JOIN course AS T2 ON T1.Course_ID  =  T2.Course_ID JOIN teacher AS T3 ON T1.Teacher_ID  =  T3.Teacher_ID ORDER BY T3.Name
column6: SELECT T1.Name, T2.Course FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID ORDER BY T1.Name ASC

column4: List the most common hometown of teachers.
column5: SELECT Hometown FROM teacher GROUP BY Hometown ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1
column6: SELECT T1.Hometown FROM teacher AS T1 JOIN course_arrange AS T2 ON T1.Teacher_ID = T2.Teacher_ID GROUP BY T1.Hometown ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

column4: Return the different descriptions for templates that have been used in a document.
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T1.template_type_description FROM Ref_template_types AS T1 JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.template_type_code  = T2.template_type_code JOIN Documents AS T3 ON T2.Template_ID  =  T3.template_ID
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T2.Template_Type_Description FROM Documents AS T1 INNER JOIN Templates AS T2 ON T1.Template_ID = T2.Template_ID

column4: List the emails of the professionals who live in the state of Hawaii or the state of Wisconsin.
column5: SELECT email_address FROM Professionals WHERE state  =  'Hawaii' OR state  =  'Wisconsin'
column6: SELECT DISTINCT T3.email_address FROM Owners AS T1 INNER JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id INNER JOIN Professionals AS T3 ON T1.owner_id = T3.owner_id WHERE T2.state = 'Hawaii' OR T2.state = 'Wisconsin'

column4: List each owner's first name, last name, and the size of his for her dog.
column5: SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T2.size_code FROM Owners AS T1 JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id
column6: SELECT T3.first_name, T3.last_name, T2.size_description FROM Owners AS T1 INNER JOIN Dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id INNER JOIN Sizes AS T3 ON T2.size_code = T3.size_code

column4: What are each professional's first name and description of the treatment they have performed?
column5: SELECT DISTINCT T1.first_name ,  T3.treatment_type_description FROM professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id JOIN Treatment_types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code  =  T3.treatment_type_code
column6: SELECT T3.first_name, T2.treatment_type_description FROM Professionals AS T1 INNER JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id INNER JOIN Treatment_Types AS T3 ON T2.treatment_type_code = T3.treatment_type_code

column4: Find the id, last name and cell phone of the professionals who live in the state of Indiana or have performed more than two treatments.
column5: SELECT professional_id ,  last_name ,  cell_number FROM Professionals WHERE state  =  'Indiana' UNION SELECT T1.professional_id ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id  =  T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*)  >  2
column6: SELECT T3.professional_id ,  T3.last_name ,  T3.cell_number FROM Professionals AS T1 INNER JOIN Owners AS T2 ON T1.owner_id = T2.owner_id INNER JOIN Addresses AS T3 ON T2.address_id = T3.address_id WHERE T3.state = 'Indiana' OR COUNT(T1.professional_id) > 2

column4: Which shops run with no employees? Find the shop names
column5: SELECT name FROM shop WHERE shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM hiring)
column6: SELECT T2.Name FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Shop_ID WHERE T2.Employee_ID IS NULL

column4: Find the name of the shops that do not hire any employee.
column5: SELECT name FROM shop WHERE shop_id NOT IN (SELECT shop_id FROM hiring)
column6: SELECT T2.Name FROM shop AS T1 JOIN hiring AS T2 ON T1.Shop_ID = T2.Shop_ID WHERE T2.Employee_ID IS NULL

column4: Return the number of airlines in the USA.
column5: SELECT count(*) FROM AIRLINES WHERE Country  =  "USA"
column6: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.Airline) FROM airlines AS T1 INNER JOIN airports AS T2 ON T1.Abbreviation = T2.CountryAbbrev WHERE T2.Country = 'USA'

column4: Which city and country is the Alton airport at?
column5: SELECT City ,  Country FROM AIRPORTS WHERE AirportName  =  "Alton"
column6: SELECT T2.City, T2.Country FROM airports AS T1 INNER JOIN cities AS T2 ON T1.CountryAbbrev = T2.Country WHERE T1.AirportCode = 'ALTN'

column4: How many friends does each student have?
column5: SELECT student_id ,  count(*) FROM Friend GROUP BY student_id
column6: SELECT COUNT(T1.friend_id) AS num_friends FROM Friend AS T1 INNER JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.friend_id = T2.ID GROUP BY T2.name

column4: Show the names of high school students and their corresponding number of friends.
column5: SELECT T2.name ,  count(*) FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id
column6: SELECT T1.name, COUNT(T2.student_id) FROM Highschooler AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.friend_id GROUP BY T1.id

column4: What are the names of high schoolers who both have friends and are liked?
column5: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id INTERSECT SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.liked_id  =  T2.id
column6: SELECT T1.name FROM Highschooler AS T1 JOIN Friend AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.friend_id JOIN Likes AS T3 ON T2.student_id = T3.student_id WHERE T3.liked_id = T1.id

column4: Count the number of likes for each student id.
column5: SELECT student_id ,  count(*) FROM Likes GROUP BY student_id
column6: SELECT COUNT(student_id) FROM Likes

column4: How many orchestras does each record company manage?
column5: SELECT Record_Company ,  COUNT(*) FROM orchestra GROUP BY Record_Company
column6: SELECT COUNT(T2.Record_Company) AS Number_of_Orchestras, T1.Record_Company FROM orchestra AS T1 JOIN performance AS T2 ON T1.Orchestra_ID = T2.Orchestra_ID GROUP BY T1.Record_Company

column4: What are years of founding for orchestras that have had more than a single performance?
column5: SELECT Year_of_Founded FROM orchestra AS T1 JOIN performance AS T2 ON T1.Orchestra_ID  =  T2.Orchestra_ID GROUP BY T2.Orchestra_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >  1
column6: SELECT YEAR_OF_FOUND FROM ORCHESTRA WHERE ORCHESTRA_ID IN (SELECT ORCHESTRA_ID FROM PERFORMANCE GROUP BY ORCHESTRA_ID HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

column4: Find the average and maximum age for each type of pet.
column5: SELECT avg(pet_age) ,  max(pet_age) ,  pettype FROM pets GROUP BY pettype
column6: SELECT AVG(PetAge) AS Avg_Age, MAX(PetAge) AS Max_Age FROM Pets

column4: What is the last name of the student who has a cat that is 3 years old?
column5: SELECT T1.lname FROM student AS T1 JOIN has_pet AS T2 ON T1.stuid  =  T2.stuid JOIN pets AS T3 ON T3.petid  =  T2.petid WHERE T3.pet_age  =  3 AND T3.pettype  =  'cat'
column6: SELECT T2.LName FROM Has_Pet AS T1 INNER JOIN Pets AS T2 ON T1.PetID = T2.PetID WHERE T2.PetType = 'cat' AND T2.pet_age = 3

column4: Give the names of poker players who have earnings above 300000.
column5: SELECT T1.Name FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID WHERE T2.Earnings  >  300000
column6: SELECT T1.Name FROM poker_player AS T1 INNER JOIN people AS T2 ON T1.People_ID = T2.People_ID WHERE T1.Earnings > 300000

column4: What is the birth date of the poker player with the lowest earnings?
column5: SELECT T1.Birth_Date FROM people AS T1 JOIN poker_player AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T2.Earnings ASC LIMIT 1
column6: SELECT T1.Birth_Date FROM poker_player AS T1 INNER JOIN people AS T2 ON T1.People_ID = T2.People_ID ORDER BY T1.Earnings ASC LIMIT 1

column4: What are the names of properties that are either houses or apartments with more than 1 room?
column5: SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "House" UNION SELECT property_name FROM Properties WHERE property_type_code  =  "Apartment" AND room_count  >  1
column6: SELECT T1.property_name FROM Properties AS T1 INNER JOIN Other_Property_Features AS T2 ON T1.property_id = T2.property_id WHERE T1.room_count > 1 OR T1.property_type_code IN ('House', 'Apartment')

column4: Show the property type descriptions of properties belonging to that code.
column5: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code  =  T2.property_type_code GROUP BY T1.property_type_code
column6: SELECT T2.property_type_description FROM Properties AS T1 INNER JOIN Ref_Property_Types AS T2 ON T1.property_type_code = T2.property_type_code WHERE T1.property_type_code = 'your_property_type_code'

column4: Show the name of singers whose birth year is either 1948 or 1949?
column5: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Birth_Year  =  1948 OR Birth_Year  =  1949
column6: SELECT T2.Name FROM singer AS T1 INNER JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID WHERE T1.Birth_Year IN (1948, 1949)

column4: What's the name of the course with most number of enrollments?
column5: SELECT  T1.course_name FROM Courses AS T1 JOIN Student_Enrolment_Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id  =  T2.course_id GROUP BY T1.course_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
column6: SELECT T2.course_name FROM Student_Enrolment AS T1 INNER JOIN Courses AS T2 ON T1.course_id = T2.course_id GROUP BY T2.course_name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

column4: What are the last name of the students who live in North Carolina but have not registered in any degree programs?
column5: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id  =  T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county  =  'NorthCarolina' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT T3.last_name FROM Students AS T3 JOIN Student_Enrolment AS T4 ON T3.student_id  =  T4.student_id
column6: SELECT T1.last_name FROM Students AS T1 INNER JOIN Addresses AS T2 ON T1.current_address_id = T2.address_id WHERE T2.state_province_county LIKE 'North Carolina' AND T1.date_first_registered IS NULL

column4: Which department offers the most number of degrees? List department name and id.
column5: SELECT T2.department_name ,  T1.department_id FROM Degree_Programs AS T1 JOIN Departments AS T2 ON T1.department_id  =  T2.department_id GROUP BY T1.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1
column6: SELECT T2.department_name ,  T2.department_id FROM departments AS T1 JOIN degree_programs AS T2 ON T1.department_id = T2.department_id GROUP BY T2.department_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

column4: What are the ids of the TV channels that do not have any cartoons directed by Ben Jones?
column5: SELECT id FROM TV_Channel EXCEPT SELECT channel FROM cartoon WHERE directed_by  =  'Ben Jones'
column6: SELECT T2.id FROM TV_channel AS T1 INNER JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.channel WHERE T2.directed_by != 'Ben Jones'

column4: What is the episode for the TV series named "Sky Radio"?
column5: SELECT T2.Episode FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN TV_series AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T1.series_name = "Sky Radio";
column6: SELECT T2.Episode FROM TV_series AS T1 INNER JOIN TV_Channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id WHERE T1.Series_name = 'Sky Radio'

column4: Find the series name and country of the tv channel that is playing some cartoons directed by Ben Jones and Michael Chang?
column5: SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Michael Chang' INTERSECT SELECT T1.series_name ,  T1.country FROM TV_Channel AS T1 JOIN cartoon AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.Channel WHERE T2.directed_by  =  'Ben Jones'
column6: SELECT T2.series_name ,  T2.Country FROM Cartoon AS T1 JOIN TV_channel AS T2 ON T1.channel = T2.id WHERE T1.directed_by IN ('Ben Jones' ,  'Michael Chang')

column4: What are the titles of all cartoons directed by Ben Jones or Brandon Vietti?
column5: SELECT Title FROM Cartoon WHERE Directed_by = "Ben Jones" OR Directed_by = "Brandon Vietti";
column6: SELECT T2.Title FROM Cartoon AS T1 INNER JOIN TV_Channel AS T2 ON T1.Channel = T2.id WHERE T1.Directed_by IN ('Ben Jones', 'Brandon Vietti')

column4: What are the create dates, states, and phone numbers of the votes that were for the contestant named 'Tabatha Gehling'?
column5: SELECT T2.created ,  T2.state ,  T2.phone_number FROM contestants AS T1 JOIN votes AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number  =  T2.contestant_number WHERE T1.contestant_name  =  'Tabatha Gehling'
column6: SELECT T1.created, T2.state, T3.phone_number FROM VOTES AS T1 INNER JOIN CONTESTANTS AS T2 ON T1.contestant_number = T2.contestant_number INNER JOIN AREA_CODE_STATE AS T3 ON T1.state = T3.state WHERE T2.contestant_name = 'Tabatha Gehling'

column4: What are the African countries that have a  population less than any country in Asia?
column5: SELECT Name FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Africa"  AND population  <  (SELECT max(population) FROM country WHERE Continent  =  "Asia")
column6: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN country AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.Code WHERE T1.Continent = 'Africa' AND T1.Population < ( SELECT MIN(Population) FROM country WHERE Continent = 'Asia' )

column4: What are the names of nations where both English and French are official languages?
column5: SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "English" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T" INTERSECT SELECT T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language  =  "French" AND T2.IsOfficial  =  "T"
column6: SELECT T2.Name FROM country AS T1 INNER JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode WHERE T2.Language IN ('English', 'French')

column4: Return the country codes for countries that do not speak English.
column5: SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage EXCEPT SELECT CountryCode FROM countrylanguage WHERE LANGUAGE  =  "English"
column6: SELECT T1.code FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.code = T2.countrycode WHERE T2.language != 'English'

column4: Return the country name and the numbers of languages spoken for each country that speaks at least 3 languages.
column5: SELECT COUNT(T2.Language) ,  T1.Name FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code  =  T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T1.Name HAVING COUNT(*)  >  2
column6: SELECT T2.Name ,  COUNT(T1.Language) FROM country AS T1 JOIN countrylanguage AS T2 ON T1.Code = T2.CountryCode GROUP BY T2.Name HAVING COUNT(T1.Language) >= 3

column4: List the first name and birth date of all players from the country with code USA.
column5: SELECT first_name ,  birth_date FROM players WHERE country_code  =  'USA'
column6: SELECT T1.first_name, T1.birth_date FROM players AS T1 INNER JOIN countries AS T2 ON T1.country_code = T2.code WHERE T2.name = 'USA'

column4: What are the country code and first name of the players who won in both tourney WTA Championships and Australian Open?
column5: SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name  =  'WTA Championships' INTERSECT SELECT T1.country_code ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name  =  'Australian Open'
column6: SELECT T1.country_code, T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 INNER JOIN matches AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.winner_id WHERE T2.tourney_name IN ('WTA Championships', 'Australian Open')

column4: What are the first names of all players, and their average rankings?
column5: SELECT avg(ranking) ,  T1.first_name FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id  =  T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name
column6: SELECT T1.first_name, AVG(T2.ranking_points) FROM players AS T1 JOIN rankings AS T2 ON T1.player_id = T2.player_id GROUP BY T1.first_name

column4: How many car models are produced in the usa?
column5: SELECT count(*) FROM MODEL_LIST AS T1 JOIN CAR_MAKERS AS T2 ON T1.Maker  =  T2.Id JOIN COUNTRIES AS T3 ON T2.Country  =  T3.CountryId WHERE T3.CountryName  =  'usa';
column6: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T2.Model) FROM car_names AS T1 INNER JOIN model_list AS T2 ON T1.Model = T2.Model WHERE T1.Make IN (SELECT Id FROM car_makers WHERE Country = 'USA')
